keyPhrases.text: crushed beneath the director's insistence on a vision that feels narrow and doctrinaire
all we can see is him
determined to snuff out any lightness
There's no joy to be found

reasoning: Harsh criticism of van Hove's directorial choices dominates, calling the production 'infuriating' and criticizing his 'narrow and doctrinaire' vision. While acknowledging some positive elements (costumes, Sondheim's lyrics), the overall assessment is that the director's style has 'calcified into shtick' and obscures rather than illuminates the work.
